builds.goal: Reference for Lucian: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A short-range marksman who alternates spells with double attacks and uses those hits to recycle his dash. Ally shielding or nearby immobilization adds another attack empowerment window. Count Lightslinger attacks and dash cooldown recycling, with ally empowerment state recorded. Crit and physical pick routes need real spell/attack alternation rather than permanent double shots. Crit and attacks between compatible spells test cooldown recycling and mana-supported trading.

builds.goal: Test ardent hybrid shots against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Ardent Blaze has 0.9 AP magic damage and The Culling has 0.15 AP per physical bullet; Nashor plus Dusk and Dawn tests attacks after spell casts, while Gunblade retains AD. Lightslinger also reduces dash cooldown, though its second-shot item behavior must be measured.
testPlan: Required state: Land W and weave actual attacks before a safe Culling channel.
Record W, each attack packet and completed R separately.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: AP weakens Q and missing crit lowers R's bullet-count source expression.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: AP does not turn Culling into magic, and two shots are not assumed to double every on-hit.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Dusk and Dawn, Hextech Gunblade, Rabadon's Deathcap, Terminus, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
